How trust scores work

Real reputation. Four sources. One score.

We pull each photographer's public ratings weekly, weight them by source, and publish a single composite score. Photographers can't edit it. We don't sell placement.

Google Reviews

Star rating + review count from your Google Business profile.

Yelp

Star rating and reviews from Yelp — especially strong for local service businesses.

Instagram

Follower count as a proxy for audience trust and reach.

Facebook

Recommendations and page rating from your Facebook business page.

Scores are verified and tamper-proof

Photographers link their public profiles. We pull ratings directly from each platform. There's no way for a photographer to boost, hide, or manipulate their score on TrueNorth Frames.

For photographers

How to get discovered

01

Create your profile

Sign up as a photographer, fill in your bio, specialties, rate, and location. Takes about 20 minutes start to finish.

02

Connect your reviews

Add your Google, Yelp, Instagram and Facebook profile links. We pull your existing reputation automatically and build your trust score.

03

Upload your portfolio

Add up to 20 portfolio photos. Your best work, curated. Clients can browse your gallery before they reach out.

04

Receive enquiries

Clients find you, read your trust score, and message you directly. You get notified instantly. No bidding, no algorithm to game.

FAQ

Common questions

Do I need an account to browse photographers?

No. Anyone can browse, search, and read photographer profiles without signing up. You only need a free account when you want to send a message.

Is there a fee for clients?

Never. TrueNorth Frames is completely free for clients — no booking fees, no service charges, no hidden costs. We never take a cut of your session.

How is the trust score calculated?

We pull each photographer's rating from Google Reviews, Yelp, Instagram, and Facebook, then compute a weighted composite score. Scores update weekly. Photographers cannot edit or influence their own score.

What happens after I send a message?

The photographer receives your message directly and replies through the platform. You'll get an email notification when they respond. All messages are stored in your dashboard.

Can I book directly through TrueNorth Frames?

Right now, we facilitate the introduction. You negotiate timing and payment directly with your photographer — we stay out of it. That keeps the relationship honest and fee-free.

Are all photographers based in Edmonton?

Yes. We're focused exclusively on Edmonton and the surrounding area (including St. Albert and Sherwood Park). Local-only is a deliberate choice — we'd rather be the best local product than a mediocre national one.

Ready to get started?

No account needed to browse. Free to join when you're ready.
